title: Shapes and Polymorphism
description: Create classes `Rectangle(w, h)`, `Square(side)` and `Circle(r)` that each have `area()`. Use `3.14` as pi, so `Circle(2).area()` is `12.56`. Also write `total_area(shapes)` returning the sum of areas.
starter_code: # Write Rectangle, Square, Circle and total_area
